eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Relationship Queries

code:
SELECT Id, Name
FROM Account
WHERE Id IN (
  SELECT AccountId
  FROM Opportunity
  WHERE StageName = 'Closed Won')
caption: Accounts with at least one Closed Won deal.

code:
SELECT Id, Name
FROM Account
WHERE Id NOT IN (
  SELECT AccountId
  FROM Opportunity)
caption: Accounts with no Opportunity at all. No EXISTS in SOQL.

steps.label: One field
steps.sub: must be an Id or lookup field

steps.label: No sorting
steps.sub: no ORDER BY or LIMIT inside
